verdict.rationale: Riveter supports scraping/enrichment at scale via async runs with up to 10,000 rows per request, webhook callbacks instead of polling, retries/pagination handled by SDKs, and dedicated 'scrape' and 'quick_search' tools for URL-to-text extraction — all pointing to asynchronous batch processing suited for large URL lists. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on benchmarks of actual throughput at 'thousands of URLs', no explicit documentation of concurrency limits or rate-limit ceilings for very large batches, and openapi/llms.txt probes 404 so some architectural details are unverifiable.
